component.name: Trama
component.summary: Record your screen with overlays from the terminal
Graba tu pantalla con overlays desde la terminal

description.p: Trama is a terminal screen recorder and compositor for Linux, powered by GPU Screen Recorder.
Arrange PNG, JPG and animated GIF layers, configure a microphone-reactive avatar, and save reusable TOML profiles.
Record system audio and microphone to MKV with GPU-encoded H.264 video. The capture engine is included.

This experimental release targets Wayland on x86_64. Recording has been tested on Pop!_OS with COSMIC and Intel Iris Xe. Other systems may work but are not yet verified. Compatible GPU encoding and system authorization are required.
Initial experimental Flatpak with overlays, microphone-reactive avatar and reusable profiles.
